notes.notes:
Game balancing improvements (weapon stats, loot, coin and experience gain, among others)

notes.title: Major Prologue Update
notes.notes:
Here's fresh news for our brave defenders of Sherwood! Today, at 1:00 PM UTC / 8:00 AM EST, we're introducing a major prologue update to the game "Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders: Bandit's Trail". Check out the improvements which are also in store for you in the final version of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/9d19caf14c55a5c636676f601be6881e671d33a7.png

Our team has taken your feedback to heart and improved many aspects of the gameplay. Now you can enjoy better game balancing, performance, and controller support! Here are the main changes:


 Game balancing improvements (weapon stats, loot, coin and experience gain, among others)
 Performance tweaks, including generic foliage and navmesh optimization
 Gamepad support added
 Several fixes improving the resource extraction system
 New enemy abilities
 Rebalancing for Robin's character development, different types of enemies and building costs
 Numerous AI improvements and fixes
 Stamina system improvements
 Stealth system improvements and dynamic character visibility scaling
 Player visibility gauge added
 Difficulty setting improvements (AI detection range is also affected by game difficulty)
 New enemy hairstyles and beards
 Status effect resistance system
 Enemy health bar now shows level and stealth kill possibility
 Visual prompts for enemy sight and hearing range added to Hunter Vision
 Combat system improvements (for example, parrying now adds a short invincibility window)
 Option of selecting time of day when resting
 Sort button for inventory
 NPC idle dialogues and monologues
 Redecorated character treehouses

The scope of the updates means that your current saved game files will not work with the newly updated version of the prologue. Please take particular note of that fact.

But that's not all! At 2:00 PM UTC / 9:00 AM EST, we're also starting a livestream of gameplay from the updated prologue! Join us on the Bandit's Trail Steam page as we delve into the heart of the fight for justice!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465830/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders__Bandits_Trail/

And there's still more! We'd like to remind you that in just one week, we're embarking on a full adventure with the premiere of the full game version! Are you ready to become a legend of Sherwood?

LAUNCH ON FEBRUARY 29 2024
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159420/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders/

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Real Gameplay Difficulty | Full Release in Q1 2024!
notes.notes:
📣 Hello Sherwood Builders! 🏹 

Release News

Are you still following us here like we suggested? If you are, good for you, cause you won't be missing out on this juicy bit of news:

Robin Hood: Sherwood Builders, the final version of the game, is set to have... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/e2b2a7bb19f0dbfa4b8ef852515b73ee3c8f31c7.png

:pointdown: Add the game to your wishlist so that you don't miss our grand premiere! :pointdown:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159420/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders/

And keep following us for a more precise date in a news post to come!

Gameplay Difficulty in Sherwood Builders

Many games don't manage their difficulty design in a fair way, especially when it comes to combat. This is mostly done by having the difficulty setting modify the stats of characters and creating so-called damage sponges – enemies who force you into a slog of being battered for a long period of time until they're finally defeated. While at it, the fight doesn't offer much in the way of new combat gameplay and only either shorterns or lengthens the loop that's already in place.

We wanted a different approach, one that would address gameplay challenge through combat and, consequently, actually mean something to the player. And so, the three different difficulty levels of Sherwood Builders: Rogue, Outlaw, and Legend affect the way enemies behave alongside several other combat-related conditions:

 Damage caused by enemies
 Frequency of enemy attacks
 Number of enemies willing to attack at the same time
 Chances of various enemy responses, such as blocking and dodging
 The rate at which Robin gets fatigued by fighting
 The timing window for the player to parry attacks
 Item drop chances

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/3e6d33fc275dbc088495352bc99eaf7fb5dbc1c2.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/139a99cbb1a3af8e1699d1e0dd6c46c68b602051.gif

With these solutions combined, we intend for the game difficulty to engage the player's skills, reward how much practice they've had with the game, and how great a challenge they wish to face as they complete the quests and follow the story.

Which feature of the game would you like us to write about in the next update? Let us know in the comments below!

More news to come!
MeanAstronauts Team
